servinfosub.title: DTC Detecting Condition and Trouble Area

ptxt.emph: B1032-00: Front Air Bag Deployment Record

entry.ptxt: Deployment of front air bag has been recorded in SDM.
If this DTC has been recorded even though air bag or pretensioner has not been deployed

item.ptxt: Driver and/or passenger air bag (inflator) module
Driver and/or passenger front seat belt pretensioner
Left-side and/or right-side rear seat belt pretensioner

ptxt.emph: B1033-00: Side Air Bag Deployment Record (Driver Side)

entry.ptxt: Deployment of driver side-air bag (inflator) module has been recorded in SDM.

ptxt.emph: B1034-00: Side Air Bag Deployment Record (Passenger Side)

entry.ptxt: Deployment of passenger side-air bag (inflator) module has been recorded in SDM.

ptxt.emph: B1035-00: Seat Belt Pretensioner Activation Record

entry.ptxt: Activation of front seat belt pretensioner has been recorded in SDM.

ptxt.emph: B1036-00: Curtain Air Bag Deployment Record (Driver Side)

entry.ptxt: Deployment of driver curtain air bag (inflator) module has been recorded in SDM.

ptxt.emph: B1037-00: Curtain Air Bag Deployment Record (Passenger Side)

entry.ptxt: Deployment of passenger curtain air bag (inflator) module has been recorded in SDM.

ptxt.emph: B1039-00: Rear Seat Belt Pretensioner Activation Record

entry.ptxt: Activation of rear seat belt pretensioner has been recorded in SDM.

attention3.ptxt: If DTC B1032-00, B1033-00, B1034-00, B1035-00, B1036-00, B1037-00 or B1039-00 is stored in SDM, it is not possible to clear DTC.

testgroup.question: Was “Air Bag Diagnostic System Check” performed?

action.ptxt: Go to Air Bag Diagnostic System Check .

attention3.ptxt: Upon completion of inspection and repair work, perform the following items.

item.ptxt: Reconnect all air bag system components and check that all components are properly mounted.
Repeat Air Bag Diagnostic System Check to check that the trouble has been solved.
